rules: Constitution II and .specify/memory/architecture.md require inward layers, application-owned ports, adapter-owned effects, SDK isolation, acyclic siblings, facade exclusion and preserved public/data/recovery contracts.

modules.responsibility: Pure upload row selection, validation and identity policy
modules.interface: Eligible-row selection and ordered bbox columns; unchanged validation/fingerprint semantics

modules.responsibility: Frame mapping, pure shape/issue DTO construction and client operations
modules.interface: Existing client method contracts and TaskWriteSession; preserve row mapping, tolerance and one-to-one matching
modules.effects: External operations only through supplied ports; mapping is pure

modules.responsibility: Typed upload planning, staging, recovery and orchestration
modules.interface: Existing upload module exports, request/outcome types and manifest state machine
modules.effects: Supplied storage, file, manifest, clock and runner ports; never discover effects

modules.responsibility: CVAT SDK request policies, timeout installation, translation and endpoint DTO mapping
modules.interface: CvatApiPort; preserve read/write/idempotent policies, wrapper order and SDK errors
modules.effects: Own CVAT SDK/network calls and context-local timeout patch

modules.responsibility: Prompt-free API mapping by capability and connection lifetime
modules.interface: Preserve every supported export, signature, result/type identity and serialization contract
modules.effects: Own explicit connection context and boundary mapping; never prompt or exit

modules.responsibility: Late-bound CLI registry, dispatch and exit/error boundary
modules.interface: Unchanged commands, order, help, defaults, choices and exit behavior

modules.responsibility: Per-command parser configuration and incoming command mapping
modules.interface: Existing argparse namespaces and command handlers with shared parser helpers
modules.effects: Prompts and exits remain incoming; parsers configure arguments only

modules.responsibility: Wire invocation-time network worker and timeout settings to production adapters
modules.interface: configure_data_timeout(float | None) and configure_network(NetworkConfig); unchanged timeout/worker contexts with the transport owner imported directly
modules.effects: Calls adapter timeout installation at the existing boundary; owns no SDK requests

contracts.rules: Exhaustive inward layers, application sublayers, adapter independence, SDK/prompt ownership, facade exclusion and acyclic siblings
Domain/application are free of IO, environment, SDK, process and execution effects, including alias/local/type-only paths

checks.command: uv run lint-imports && uv run python scripts/check_architecture.py && uv run pytest -n 0 tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: Existing inward/SDK/facade/acyclic/effect rules pass, including forbidden-edge/effect negative tests.
Full non-live suite passes with configured coverage; public identity, API/CLI, upload recovery and retry behavior remain compatible.
Moved scope is preserved with zero unexplained survivors and zero stale equivalence entries.
Serial live suite passes under an owned tag; lifecycle setup and exact-tag cleanup separately recorded.

checks.command: uv run pytest -n 0 tests/test_docs.py && git diff --check
checks.expectation: Maintained local links/anchors, API/CLI/configuration documentation and baseline recovery/numbering/packaging assertions pass.

documentation: specs/baseline.md absorbs current contracts; immutable archive manifest/source links preserve history. .specify/memory/architecture.md and governance map final ownership and baseline-based feature workflow. Russian guides, AGENTS, API docstring, docs checks and sdist include point to the baseline. Companion corp-skills/skills/cveta2/references/usage.md contract link is updated and validated in its repository.

review.reviewer: Fresh read-only runtime_review and baseline_review; parent integration reconciliation
review.reconciliation: Compared complete changes from f6717f0211169f8f94c78da2bfa8dee86bfab602 plus staged runtime additions/moves/deletions. Runtime reviewer accepted ownership, interfaces, inward dependencies, effects and retained mutation scope; documentation reviewer accepted baseline/archive/governance after three missing contracts were restored. Includes composition timeout wiring and new negative boundary fixtures. Unrelated original-checkout skill links and corpus edits remain excluded; archive checkpoint preserves every retired file.
